The Bank has since implemented corrective action to strengthen its internal control mechanisms so as to ensure that such incidents do not recur.

Table.NEWSSUB: Granting Of Options Under Employee Stock Option Scheme- ESOS 31
Table.MORE:
In terms of the applicable provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Bank has today granted 3,36,000 equity stock options of the face value of Rs. 2/- ('options') each at the grant price of Rs. 2090.45 (Rupees Two Thousand Ninety and Paise Forty Five only).

Vesting of the options shall happen in four stages, based on the assessment of performance at the time of vesting:

35% of the options granted (rounded off to the nearest 100) shall vest on completion of twelve months from the date of grant i.e. 2nd February, 2020;
30% of the options granted (rounded off to the nearest 100) shall vest on completion of twenty four months from the date of grant i.e. on 2nd February, 2021;
20% of the options granted (rounded off to the nearest 100) shall vest on completion of thirty six months from the date of grant i.e. on 2nd February, 2022;
Balance options shall vest on completion of forty eight months from the date of grant i.e. on 2nd February, 2023;

The vested options need to be exercised within a period of two years from the respective dates of their vesting, failing which, they shall lapse forthwith.

The options were granted under the Scheme titled 'ESOS 31' in terms of SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits) Regulations, 2014.

We request you to kindly take note of the same.

Table.NEWSSUB: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate
Table.MORE: In terms of the provisions of Section 10-A (2A) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, no director of a banking company, other than its Chairman or Whole-Time Director, can hold office continuously for a period exceeding eight years. Mr. Bobby Parikh has completed his eight years' tenure on January 26, 2019 and has accordingly relinquished his office as Director of the Bank. The Board places on record its sincere appreciation of the contribution made by Mr. Parikh during his tenure with the Bank and wishes him the best for his future endeavors.
